fieldData.bio-excerpt: Raul Velaz started his career as a software developer and then moved to the infrastructure and DevOps areas. During this time, he has worked in different industries, including education, e-commerce and blockchain. Before Radix, Raul was the Lead DevOps for ConsenSys Solutions. He has also been involved in blockchain projects for trade finance and commodity trading.
